title: Signed genback to class assembly
objective: Connect signed ideal genback directly to class_group_assembly for the authentic x^3-200*x+7 class-[24] fixture, deriving Ge from Uir and independently replaying its ideal/order relation

oracles: native GMP and tagged differential replay

handoff.summary: Connected the authentic class-[24] cubic's internally derived Uir column [-3,-1] through signed genback, exact compact-factor adaptation, nf_cxlog, and final class-group assembly. The exact generator ideal, four ordered Ge factors, Smith order identity, Ga/GD/ga, and independent principal-ideal replay match pristine PARI under CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged backends.
risks: Candidate selection remains the explicit five-entry PARI source-order T2/LLL tape; this lane does not implement generic candidate search.
The admitted composition is deliberately restricted to cubic dimension two with one active Smith generator.
The broad test:native gate was deferred to the converged integration tree to avoid redundant multi-agent full builds.
